top_signals.title: Gold Declines as AI Doubts and Rate-Hike Bets Rattle Stocks
top_signals.summary: Gold fell, as stocks sold off on doubts over the durability of the artificial intelligence boom, and the White House’s latest tariff plans reinforced expectations of an interest-rate hike by the Federal Reserve.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Global Rotation on AI Jitters Lifts Indian Stocks to Top Spot
top_signals.summary: The Indian stock market extended a rally that has catapulted it to the top of global equity rankings this month, as renewed selling in artificial intelligence shares continues to drive investors to markets with limited exposure to the theme.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Neuberg Diagnostics Is Said to Pick Banks for $200 Million IPO
top_signals.summary: Neuberg Diagnostics Pvt. has picked banks for an initial public offering that could raise as much as $200 million, according to people familiar with the matter, adding to a busy pipeline of Indian deals.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Oil Prices Rise on Hormuz Vessel Attacks
top_signals.summary: Oil prices edged higher on Tuesday in a choppy session as new attacks were reported on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, but gains were capped by an outlook for surplus global supplies.Brent crude futures bounced off a session trough that was their lowest since August 27 and were up 45 cents…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: A 2018 Playbook Would Not Bode Well for Markets: Taking Stock
top_signals.summary: Signs suggest the market is moving past peak fear, but investors need a fresh source of conviction before returning in force — especially as the current setup revives memories of 2018’s punishing selloff in risk assets.

top_signals.title: Neptun Deep Project Will Help Economic Output
top_signals.summary: Romania's Black Sea Neptun Deep offshore gas project will add 0.2 percentage points to economic output next year and narrow the current account deficit by 0.6%, BCR bank said in a research note on Tuesday.The project is a joint venture between OMV Petrom, which is controlled by Austria's OMV OMVV.VI

top_signals.title: Heathrow third runway to stay on bills for 20 years
top_signals.summary: Passengers face paying higher fares to travel from Heathrow for the next 20 years, even if Andy Burnham abandons plans to build the third runway. Under fresh plans proposed by the aviation watchdog, the two firms bidding to manage the multi-billion-pound project will be allowed to recoup the roughly £400m associated with the planning process [...]
